note: DRAFT labels. Consensus is 2-agent + (1-LLM or pending-human), NOT 3-human — a planned deviation from roadmap section 6, to be upgraded when humans review. Pass A: author reasoning from hexagram meanings. Pass B: embedding-resonance retrieval + manual check of disagreements (a different method from A, not a copy). Pass C: pending human review — no second LLM is available through the connectors, and the baseline model (DeepSeek deepseek-chat) must not also be the annotator. Where A and B disagree, the tie-break takes pass A and flags the scenario. End hexagrams are computed from start + moving lines, never hand-typed.

annotation.pass_A: author reasoning from hexagram meanings (start + moving lines + rationale)
annotation.pass_B: embedding-resonance top-1 + v1 reasoner path, disagreements manually checked by the author
annotation.pass_C: pending-human-review — no second general LLM available via connectors (meta-model-api is FixLens photo analysis only); baseline model excluded as annotator to avoid bias
annotation.tie_break: on A/B disagreement, take pass A and flag the scenario
